role: public DEVELOPMENT decision study, TRAIN ladder and PRACTICE; never hidden, quiz, tuning or confirmation material

train_v3.draw: numpy default_rng(seed), round-robin over the 24 contexts in the menu's order (draw i of every context before draw i+1), so the first 24*m*40 rows are the nested m-times set: peak U[30, 140] W at 1 W, on-time U[5, 20] s at 0.1 s; a draw equal to a decision-study action of that context, or a duplicate, is redrawn

practice.draw: as TRAIN, separate generator; also redrawn on any TRAIN-ladder tuple
